description: Get people and payroll work done in ChatGPT with the Gusto plugin, don’t just ask questions about it. Prepare an upcoming payroll and review against recent runs to catch what needs attention before payday. Fix timesheets, bring in hours, tips, and reimbursements from spreadsheets, or onboard a new hire from their offer letter, all in a chat thread. The Gusto plugin for ChatGPT connects to your live people an payroll data, tools support detailed queries of structured data as well as writes that require confirmation.
